answer: Because the tundra reference is updated at each lantern checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the dawn audit records how much each answer added. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 3 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Repeating an already-covered mechanism therefore earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 78 aliases however many keys the operator holds. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
